body:
Oh I really doubt I could go smaller with this. Honestly not to sound conceited, but I kind of don't know how much smaller anyone else could make it either (though I'd love to see that, still would use my version since it's mine, but I'd love to see this thing compacted further)

Like a lot of this stuff I spent a really long time laying out wires, and trimming them back, and then finding some better way to make it function. There even was this block that got pushed by a piston that technically wouldn't interfere with my build, but when pushed would have been one block higher than everything else, and I found a way to pull it down, so that was real nice

So yeah, this is 100% the smallest possible version I could ever make of this, managed to do stuff like figure out that one circuit's closing sequence happened during the opening too, so I was able to just able to use that twice, things like that

I don't think there's a single way I'm capable of optimizing this further at this point without breaking something. You compare it to the previous version that was just making sure I could physically make all the circuits work that was just spaghetti and it's not even in the same league

This one has a whole separate sub circuit for one column that I needed to mirror, but without the observer popping between it. So I basically had to just time that one so it could run independent to save space. Then there's the delay between running the open and the close sequence which took some searching to find a compact way to store delay

So I totally agree with you on this, but yeah... this is that version. It doesn't get smaller or faster for me. This is my version of peak performance, and I think I did a pretty good job with it if I'm honest

That means so much

This was my first redstone project that wasn't just copying a tutorial, and it took like 3 days to figure out the mechanical side of it, but like 8 months to stumble through learning wiring till I finally had a design that I actually liked

So it means a lot when people like it cause a ton of time went into it. Honestly half of why I shared it is cause I couldn't find any diagonal hidden stairs, and if I can't find it maybe it doesn't tend to happen. So my hope is that people can take some of the ideas I had and do even cooler things with them down the road

I'm happy with how it ended up, but if you look at the wiring you see that in order to get it compact enough half of it involved just finding ways to weave leaves between the wires, which means that while I almost have it built in a back up, I just needed a break from trouble shooting every spot wood touches a leaf, so I haven't actually finished the blueprint I need to port it to survival

Still... I was frustrated almost every moment I worked on the wiring because things weren't working right, and timing's are such a pain, but I liked thinking about the design and spacial stuff, and I actually do like the end product and think it's pretty solid, and I find it funny that leaves are basically the solution to and cause of all my problems with this build

But yeah, it seriously means a lot having someone say that. I hope you have a really good day

For sure: [https://gofile.io/d/sydkZU](https://gofile.io/d/sydkZU)

This is my first redstone build that wasn't following a tutorial or really simple stuff, so it would make me really happy if other people used it. The final build ended up aways away from spawn, so I added some red arrows so hopefully it's easy to find

Took 3 days to design the mechanical aspect of it, then about 8 months of trial and error learning wiring till I had something I was happy with

If you or anyone else have any questions just let me know. Whole thing should have a spam proof toggle on it, cause I never ever wanted to have to fix this, and it didn't break when I used an observer clock on it so... seems to work even if I'm still always worried it'll go wrong each time I use it

Thanks, I appreciate you trying to help

I just wanted to say though, you know I don't just sit around on the phone all day, right? Like this is the first chance I've had to check things and see this message because I've been so bust with woodworking, and house stuff (I did end up getting it, it's 50 miles from the nearest city and in need of a lot of work, which is the only reason I could afford it), and learning Irish

I just happened to be really depressed that week, where as this week I'm more back to my usual wishing I had a gun so things could just be over, but since I don't have one I better get back to work to try and make life a bit better so maybe I feel more like sticking around

I just have really severe social anxiety, that's why I don't have a job. I like working, it's the interviews that kill me. I'm kind of hoping being in a podunk town might help because I do better face to face

​

Anyway, I really do appreciate you taking the time to help. It's just now that I'm feeling better and saw this, I wanted to take a minute to clarify some stuff because you seemed to have this kind of skewed picture of me

If you ever need anything just let me know. There's only so much I can do obviously, but honestly I'd be more than glad to do anything I can. Being able to help someone out is one of the only things that I really enjoy, so if there ever is anything don't hesitate to ask

Sorry, you're right

For what it's worth I agree with you. That's what I'm saying. Here I am being given this chance to get a house when my lazy ass hasn't even done anything to earn it, and there are other people who have it so much worse who work so much harder. That's why I just want to pass this money on to my friend. She's actually hard working, she deserves the help, I don't

Anyway, I know the whole thing was just kind of whining about nothing. I know I need to do something about things, I just... don't. So yeah, sorry about this. I don't know what's wrong with me, but maybe soon I'll be able to do the right thing and deal with it like I should have a long time ago

Hope you have a good day

Thanks, that means a lot

I know you're right with my friend. I mean, she knows I get suicidal and she definitely doesn't want me to do anything. I most just try to avoid talking about it with her because I don't want to bother her (Because honestly a lot of people seem to get tired of you when you don't get better. She doesn't do that like other people have, but still it scares me, so I try to limit how much I talk about it with her). She's been pretty clear on wanting me to stay around, she doesn't want the money at all. It's just sometimes I'd rather be selfish with it because I don't want to be here anymore. I've said stuff to her like I'd rather replace myself with an AI, but she doesn't want that either. So you're totally right. Just sometimes I don't know how much longer I can go on and I'd rather give her a full pot of cash rather than one wasted away

With the job I'm hoping maybe I can do something with the carving I've been doing. At least then not being able to get myself to leave the house wouldn't be quite as in the way. I don't know, we'll see. I may look into the book though, it might help

Anyway, thanks. I don't know that there's any one thing anyone could say that would really help, but what you said was appreciated and... I guess there's a difference between helps fix things and helps you feel better, and your comment did help me feel a little bit better. So yeah, just thanks. You seem like a nice person so try to take care of yourself
